ly.title: Page layouts
ly.sub: Which sections each shop page shows, in which order, on which screens and on which days.
ly.note: A section shows on the shop only when it has something to show. Your changes go live as soon as you save. On the home page and the category pages you can also add your own sections.

cardH.product: Sections under every product page's photos and buy column
cardH.bag: Sections of the bag beside the summary

ly.seasonal: While a Seasonal home look is live (Marketing › Seasonal home), that look's own sections show instead of this list.

sec.head: Heading
sec.rows: Wear it with · You may also like · Recently viewed

hint.hero: The big panel at the top with its pictures
hint.festive: Shows only while a festive cut-off is live
hint.sets: Shows once combos are on the shop
hint.size-finder: Shows once Find my size is on
hint.flash-sale: Shows only while a flash sale runs
hint.shop-the-look: Shows once looks are on the shop
hint.journal: Shows once the journal is on
hint.head: Breadcrumb, title and count
hint.listing: Filters, sort and the product grid
hint.info: Shows only when the page has text or questions
hint.alternatives: Shows only when the product is off sale
hint.messenger: Shows only while the Messenger button is on
hint.free: Shows only while the free delivery bar is on
hint.lines: The products, sets and size cards
hint.offer: The one offer the bag can show
hint.whatsapp: Shows only with the shop's WhatsApp number
hint.bulk: Shows only while bulk orders are on
hint.saved: Shows only while saved for later is on

ly.drag: Drag to move, or use the arrows
ly.saved: Saved. The shop shows the new layout now.
ly.resetHelp: Puts every section back in the shop's own order, shown on both screens. Nothing changes until you press Save.
ly.unsaved: Unsaved changes: the shop still shows the saved layout.
ly.readOnly: You can see this page. Changing it needs the permission to change page layouts.

err.INVALID_INPUT: Something in the list is not right ({fields}). Reload the page and try again.
err.LOCKED: A section marked "Always shown" cannot be hidden.
err.STALE: Someone saved this page a moment ago. Reload the page to see the newest layout.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission to change page layouts.
err.unauthorized: Your session ended. Sign in again.
err.network: No connection. Check the internet and try again.

fixedNote.product: The photos, the buy column and the buy bar stay as they are, so the first screen keeps its size and the buy button.
fixedNote.bag: The summary and the phone's checkout bar stay as they are.

prev.title: See the page
prev.note: This is the page as customers see it now. Save first to see your changes here.

own.title: Own layout for this category
own.on: On: this category shows its sections in its own order, set below.
own.off: Off: this category follows the order of all category pages. Its own sections below still show.
own.shared: {n} section(s) you added for all category pages also show here.

ly.duplicated: Copied. The copy starts hidden: switch it on and press Save.
ly.hideNote: A section you add is never deleted: switch it off to hide it, and on again any time. A new section starts hidden.

typeHint.banner: A big offer or announcement: words, a button and a product's picture
typeHint.offerStrip: A slim one-line offer bar (words only)
typeHint.productRow: A row of products customers slide sideways
typeHint.comboRow: Sets on sale, from one set rule or all of them
typeHint.categoryTiles: Picture tiles of the categories you pick
typeHint.richText: Your own text: paragraphs, bold and links, never code
typeHint.spacer: A little gap between two sections

f.title: Title
f.name: Name in this list
f.nameHint: Only you see it, for example "Eid offer". Customers never see it.
f.atEnd: At the end of the page
f.daysHint: Whole days in the shop's time zone. Leave empty to show it every day.
f.hrefHint: A page of the shop like /collections/polo, or a full https:// address.
f.stripNote: The strip only shows words. It never changes a price or a discount.
f.idsHint: {n} picked, shown in the order you pick them.
f.catsHint: Pick none to show every category that has products.
f.bodyHint: A blank line starts a new paragraph. **Bold** and [words](/link) work. Code and HTML are shown as plain text.
